title: Reports
description: Your own report panels and forms on Discord — with buttons or a menu, custom fields and a live preview. Submissions can be handled here and on the Discord card.
noForms: No report forms yet — create one on the “Panels & forms” tab.
replyPlaceholder: Reply to the submitter (sent in a DM)
reasonPlaceholder: Reason (optional) — the submitter gets it in a DM
deleteSubmissionText: The report and its Discord card are deleted. This can't be undone.

server.badChannel: The channel isn't a text channel of this server.
server.panelFull: This panel is full (at most 25 forms).
server.roleNotAssignable: The bot can’t assign the role “{role}” (it’s above the bot’s role, an integration role, or grants admin / moderation permissions).
server.cannotMove: This form can't be moved any further.

spec.fieldsCount: At least 1 and at most {max} fields are needed.
spec.label: Field {field} has no label.
spec.flagYesNo: The alert of field {field} can only be yes or no.
spec.flagChoice: The alert value of field {field} isn't one of its options.
spec.flagKind: Alerts only work on yes / no and choice fields (field {field}).
spec.minMax: Field {field}: the minimum is greater than the maximum.
spec.number: Field {field}: a limit isn't a number.
spec.options: Choice field {field} needs 2–{max} options (one per line).

preview.empty: There are no forms on this panel yet.
preview.selectPlaceholder: Choose what you'd like to submit…
preview.closed: None of the forms can be filled in right now.
preview.footer: Click a button and fill in the form
preview.nextHint: After submitting, the “{next} Next” button opens the next page; answers are kept for 15 minutes.

panel.channelHint: The panel message with the buttons goes here.
panel.channelMoveHint: Choosing another channel moves the panel (the old message is deleted).
panel.title: Title
panel.descriptionHint: Discord markdown works (**bold**, lists, links). Left empty, a single form's description is shown.
panel.imageHint: An https:// image link — shown at the top of the panel.
panel.imageInvalid: Only links starting with https:// work.
panel.modeButtonsHint: Every form is its own button (5 per row) — with its own label, emoji and colour.
panel.modeSelectHint: A single dropdown — tidier with many forms; the menu also shows each form's description.
panel.footerHint: A small grey line at the bottom of the panel.
panel.showIcon: Server icon next to the title
panel.noFormsYet: After saving, add forms to the panel (“New form”).

editor.typeHint: Custom: you define the fields. Built-in: a ready template with editable labels.
editor.exampleHint: Fills the editor with a ready sample — everything can be edited afterwards.
editor.title: Title
editor.panelHint: Which panel shows its button (can be moved).
editor.emojiHint: A unicode emoji or your server emoji's code (type \:name: on Discord to get it).
editor.emojiInvalid: That's not an emoji — use an emoji or a server emoji code.
editor.descriptionHint: Shown in the panel list and in the menu.
editor.fieldsHint: At most 5 fields per window — above 5, Discord asks over several pages (“Next”).
editor.replyOnlyHint: Instead of accept / reject, the leadership only replies.
editor.labelsHint: Left empty, the template's label stays (max. 45 characters).
editor.targetHint: Submissions arrive here as cards (Accept / Reject / Reply).
editor.reviewerHint: They can review (empty: Manage Server); alerts ping this role.
editor.requiredRolesHint: Only these roles (any of them); empty means everyone.
editor.cooldownHint: Per member, for this form — survives bot restarts.
editor.oneOpenHint: While a member has a pending submission, they can't send a new one (e.g. applications).
editor.threadHint: A thread opens under every submission card for the leadership to discuss.
editor.dmCopyHint: The submitter gets a summary of their answers in a DM.
editor.acceptRolesHint: E.g. the member role for applications. The bot never gives admin / moderation roles.
editor.acceptMessageHint: Sent to the submitter in a DM (optional).
editor.enabledHint: When off, the button is greyed out (not clickable) and left out of the menu.
editor.fieldHintHelp: A small grey explanation under the label.
editor.maxChoicesHint: 1 = single choice; more = several can be ticked.
editor.flagHint: This answer marks the card and pings the leadership.

builder.title: Panels ({count}/{max})
builder.description: A panel is one message in a channel: title, description, colour, banner, and below it the forms' buttons or menu. On save, the bot updates the message in place.
builder.emptyText: Create a panel (“New panel”), then add forms — custom or built-in.
builder.deletePanelText: The panel message and {count, plural, one {its form} other {all # of its forms}} are deleted; submissions are kept.
builder.deleteFormText: The form's button is removed from the panel; submissions are kept.
builder.deleteLastFormText: This is the panel's last form — the panel is deleted with it. Submissions are kept.
builder.noForms: No forms on this panel yet — “New form”.
builder.legacyText: These 7.12 forms aren't in a panel yet. After the bot updates they move in by themselves — or do it now; the posted button keeps working.
builder.loaText: The absence (LOA) button as a separate panel in its own channel — the same absence flow as on duty.

stats.emptyText: After the first submissions you'll see here who uses which form and how much.
stats.totals: {total} in total · {last30} in the last 30 days
